ayahs.textArabic: طٰسۤ ۚ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْقُرْاٰنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ṭā Sīn, tilka āyātul-qur'āni wa kitābim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Ta. Sin. THESE ARE MESSAGES of the Qur’an - a di­vine writ clear in itself and clearly showing the truth:

ayahs.textArabic: هُدًى وَّبُشْرٰى لِلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Hudaw wa busyrā lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: a guidance and a glad tiding to the believers

ayahs.textArabic: الَّذِيْنَ يُقِيْمُوْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَيُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yuqīmūnaṣ-ṣalāta wa yu'tūnaz-zakāta wa hum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: who are constant in prayer and spend in charity: for it is they, they who in their innermost are certain of the life to come!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati zayyannā lahum a‘mālahum fahum ya‘mahūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: As for those who will not believe in the life to come - behold, goodly have We made their own doings appear unto them, and so they stumble blindly to and fro

ayahs.textArabic: اُولٰۤىِٕكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَهُمْ سُوْۤءُ الْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الْاَخْسَرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ulā'ikal-lażīna lahum sū'ul-‘ażābi wa hum fil-ākhirati humul-akhsarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: It is they whom the worst of suffering awaits: for it is they, they who in the life to come shall be the greatest losers!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى الْقُرْاٰنَ مِنْ لَّدُنْ حَكِيْمٍ عَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innaka latulaqqal-qur'āna mil ladun ḥakīmin ‘alīm(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [as for thee, O believer,] verily, thou hast received this Qur’an out of the grace of One who is wise, all-knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ قَالَ مُوْسٰى لِاَهْلِهٖٓ اِنِّيْٓ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًاۗ سَاٰتِيْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوْ اٰتِيْكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż qāla mūsā li'ahlihī innī ānastu nārā(n), sa'ātīkum minhā bikhabarin au ātīkum bisyihābin qabasil la‘allakum taṣṭalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Lo! [While lost in the desert,] Moses said to his family: “Behold, I perceive a fire [far away]; I may bring you from there some tiding [as to which way we arc to pursue], or bring you [at least] a burning brand so that you might warm yourselves.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَهَا نُوْدِيَ اَنْۢ بُوْرِكَ مَنْ فِى النَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَاۗ وَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'ahā nūdiya am būrika man fin-nāri wa man ḥaulahā, wa subḥānallāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But when he came close to it, a call was sounded: “Blessed are all who are within [reach of] this fire, and all who are near it! And limitless in His glory is God, the Sustainer of all the worlds!”

ayahs.textArabic: يٰمُوْسٰٓى اِنَّهٗٓ اَنَا اللّٰهُ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā mūsā innahū anallāhul-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God spoke thus:] “O Moses! Verily I alone am God, the Almighty, the Wise!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۗفَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَاۤنٌّ وَّلّٰى مُدْبِرًا وَّلَمْ يُعَقِّبْۗ يٰمُوْسٰى لَا تَخَفْۗ اِنِّيْ لَا يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa alqi ‘aṣāk(a), falammā ra'āhā tahtazzu ka'annahā jānnuw wallā mudbiraw wa lam yu‘aqqib, yā mūsā lā takhaf, innī lā yakhāfu ladayyal-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And then He said:] “Now throw down thy staff!” But when he saw it move rapidly, as if it were a serpent, he drew back [in terror], and did not [dare to] return. [And God spoke to him again:] O Moses! Fear not - for, behold, no fear need the message-bearers have in My Presence,

ayahs.textArabic: اِلَّا مَنْ ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًاۢ بَعْدَ سُوْۤءٍ فَاِنِّيْ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Illā man ẓalama ṡumma baddala ḥusnam ba‘da sū'in fa innī gafūrur raḥīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and neither need anyone who has done wrong and then has replaced the wrong with good: for, verily, I am much-forgiving, a dis­penser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِيْ جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَاۤءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوْۤءٍۙ فِيْ تِسْعِ اٰيٰتٍ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهٖۗ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa adkhil yadaka fī jaibika takhruj baiḍā'a min gairi sū'(in), fī tis‘i āyātin ilā fir‘auna wa qaumih(ī), innahum kānū qauman fāsiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Now place thy hand into thy bosom: it will come forth [shining] white, without blemish!” [And thou shalt go] with nine [of My] messages unto Pharaoh and his people for, verily, they are people depraved!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَتْهُمْ اٰيٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُوْا هٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'athum āyātunā mubṣiratan qālū hāżā siḥrum mubīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But when Our light-giving messages came unto them, they said, “This is clearly [but] spellbinding deception!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَحَدُوْا بِهَا وَاسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ اَنْفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًا وَّعُلُوًّاۗ فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُفْسِدِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jaḥadū bihā wastaiqanathā anfusuhum ẓulmaw wa ‘uluwwā(n), fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mufsidīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: - and in their wickedness and self-exaltation they rejected them, although their minds were convinced of their truth: and behold what hap­pened in the end to those spreaders of corruption!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ عِلْمًاۗ وَقَالَا الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ فَضَّلَنَا عَلٰى كَثِيْرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ātainā dāwūda wa sulaimāna ‘ilmā(n), wa qālal-ḥamdu lillāhil-lażī faḍḍalanā ‘alā kaṡīrim min ‘ibādihil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND, INDEED, We granted [true] knowledge unto David and Solomon [as well]; and both were wont to say: All praise is due to God, who has [thus] favoured us above many of His believing servants!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمٰنُ دَاوٗدَ وَقَالَ يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ وَاُوْتِيْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍۗ اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الْفَضْلُ الْمُبِيْنُ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa wariṡa sulaimānu dāwūda wa qāla yā ayyuhan-nāsu ‘ullimnā manṭiqaṭ-ṭairi wa ūtīnā min kulli syai'(in), inna hāżā lahuwal-faḍlul-mubīn(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [in this insight] Solomon was [truly] David’s heir; and he would say: “O you people! We have been taught the speech of birds, and have been given [in abundance] of all [good] things: this, behold, is indeed a manifest favour [from God]!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمٰنَ جُنُوْدُهٗ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَالْاِنْسِ وَالطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḥusyira lisulaimāna junūduhū minal-jinni wal-insi waṭ-ṭairi fahum yūza‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [one day] there were assembled before Solomon his hosts of invisible beings, and of men, and of birds; and then they were led forth in orderly ranks,

ayahs.textArabic: حَتّٰىٓ اِذَآ اَتَوْا عَلٰى وَادِ النَّمْلِۙ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يّٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّمْلُ ادْخُلُوْا مَسٰكِنَكُمْۚ  لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمٰنُ وَجُنُوْدُهٗۙ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥattā iżā atau ‘alā wādin-naml(i), qālat namlatuy yā ayyuhan-namludkhulū masākinakum, lā yaḥṭimannakum sulaimānu wa junūduhū wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: till, when they came upon a valley [full] of ants, an ant exclaimed: “O you ants! Get into your dwellings, lest Solomon and his hosts crush you without [even] being aware [of you]!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًا مِّنْ قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ اَوْزِعْنِيْٓ اَنْ اَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِيْٓ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلٰى وَالِدَيَّ وَاَنْ اَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضٰىهُ وَاَدْخِلْنِيْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِيْ عِبَادِكَ الصّٰلِحِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fatabassama ḍāḥikam min qaulihā wa qāla rabbi auzi‘nī an asykura ni‘matakal-latī an‘amta ‘alayya wa ‘alā wālidayya wa an a‘mala ṣāliḥan tarḍāhu wa adkhilnī biraḥmatika fī ‘ibādikaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon [Solomon] smiled joyously at her words, and said: “O my Sustainer! Inspire me so that I may forever be grateful for those blessings of Thine with which Thou hast graced me and my parents, and that I may do what is right [in a manner] that will please Thee; and include me, by Thy grace, among Thy righteous servants!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ الطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِيَ لَآ اَرَى الْهُدْهُدَۖ اَمْ كَانَ مِنَ الْغَاۤىِٕبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tafaqqadaṭ-ṭaira fa qāla mā liya lā aral-hudhud(a), am kāna minal-gā'ibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [one day] he looked in vain for [a parti­cular one of] the birds; and so he said: How is it that I do not see the hoopoe? Or could he be among the absent?

ayahs.textArabic: لَاُعَذِّبَنَّهٗ عَذَابًا شَدِيْدًا اَوْ لَاَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهٗٓ اَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّيْ بِسُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: La'u‘ażżibannahū ‘ażāban syadīdan au la'ażbaḥannahū au laya'tiyannī bisulṭānim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [If so,] I will punish him most severely or will kill him unless he bring me a convincing excuse!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيْدٍ فَقَالَ اَحَطْتُّ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهٖ وَجِئْتُكَ مِنْ سَبَاٍ ۢبِنَبَاٍ يَّقِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Famakaṡa gaira ba‘īdin faqāla aḥaṭtu bimā lam tuḥiṭ bihī wa ji'tuka min saba'im binaba'iy yaqīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: But [the hoopoe] tarried but a short while; and [when it came] it said: “I have encompassed [with my knowledge] something that thou hast never yet encompassed [with thine] - for I have come to thee from Sheba with a tiding sure!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنِّيْ وَجَدْتُّ امْرَاَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَاُوْتِيَتْ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَّلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Innī wajattumra'atan tamlikuhum wa ūtiyat min kulli syai'iw wa lahā ‘arsyun ‘aẓīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Behold, I found there a woman ruling over them; and she has been given [abundance] of all [good] things, and hers is a mighty throne,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَدْتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُوْنَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيْطٰنُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ السَّبِيْلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wajattuhā wa qaumahā yasjudūna lisy-syamsi min dūnillāhi wa zayyana lahumusy-syaiṭānu a‘mālahum fa ṣaddahum ‘anis-sabīli fahum lā yahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And I found her and her people adoring the sun instead of God; and Satan has made these doings of theirs seem goodly to them, and [thus] has barred them from the path [of God], so that they cannot find the right way:

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّا يَسْجُدُوْا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ يُخْرِجُ الْخَبْءَ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُوْنَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Allā yasjudū lillāhil-lażī yukhrijul-khab'a fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa ya‘lamu mā tukhfūna wa mā tu‘linūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [for they have come to believe] that they ought not to adore God [although it is He] who brings forth all that is hidden in the heavens and on earth, and knows all that you would conceal as well as all that you bring into the open:

ayahs.textArabic: اَللّٰهُ لَآ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۙ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيْمِ ۩
ayahs.textLatin: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbul-‘arsyil-‘aẓīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: God, save whom there is no deity - the Sustainer, in awesome almightiness enthroned!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنْظُرُ اَصَدَقْتَ اَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla sananẓuru aṣadaqta am kunta minal-kāżibīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Solomon]: “We shall see whether thou hast told the truth or art one of the liars!

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْهَبْ بِّكِتٰبِيْ هٰذَا فَاَلْقِهْ اِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَانْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Iżhab bikitābī hāżā fa alqih ilaihim ṡumma tawalla ‘anhum fanẓur māżā yarji‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Go with this my letter and convey it to them; and thereafter withdraw from them and see what [answer] they return.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اِنِّيْٓ اُلْقِيَ اِلَيَّ كِتٰبٌ كَرِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat yā ayyuhal-mala'u innī ulqiya ilayya kitābun karīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: [When the Queen had read Solomon’s letter,] she said: “O you nobles! A truly distinguished letter has been conveyed unto me.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّهٗ مِنْ سُلَيْمٰنَ وَاِنَّهٗ بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِيْمِ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innahū min sulaimāna wa innahū bismillāhir-raḥmānir-raḥīm(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, it is from Solomon, and it says, ‘In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Dispenser of Grace:

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَّا تَعْلُوْا عَلَيَّ وَأْتُوْنِيْ مُسْلِمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Allā ta‘lū ‘alayya wa'tūnī muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [God says:] Exalt not yourselves against Me, but come unto Me in willing surrender!’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اَفْتُوْنِيْ فِيْٓ اَمْرِيْۚ مَا كُنْتُ قَاطِعَةً اَمْرًا حَتّٰى تَشْهَدُوْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat yā ayyuhal-mala'u aftūnī fī amrī, mā kuntu qāṭi‘atan amran ḥattā tasyhadūn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: She added: “O you nobles! Give me your opinion on the problem with which I am now faced; I would never make a [weighty] decision unless you are present with me.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا نَحْنُ اُولُوْا قُوَّةٍ وَّاُولُوْا بَأْسٍ شَدِيْدٍ ەۙ وَّالْاَمْرُ اِلَيْكِ فَانْظُرِيْ مَاذَا تَأْمُرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū naḥnu ulū quwwatiw wa ulū ba'sin syadīd(in), wal-amru ilaiki fanẓurī māżā ta'murīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “We are endowed with power and with mighty prowess in war - but the command is thine; consider, then, what thou wouldst command.”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَتْ اِنَّ الْمُلُوْكَ اِذَا دَخَلُوْا قَرْيَةً اَفْسَدُوْهَا وَجَعَلُوْٓا اَعِزَّةَ اَهْلِهَآ اَذِلَّةً ۚوَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālat innal-mulūka iżā dakhalū qaryatan afsadūhā wa ja‘alū a‘izzata ahlihā ażillah(tan), wa każālika yaf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said she: “Verily, whenever kings enter a country they corrupt it, and turn the noblest of its people into the most abject. And this is the way they [always] behave?

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنِّيْ مُرْسِلَةٌ اِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنٰظِرَةٌ ۢبِمَ يَرْجِعُ الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innī mursilatun ilaihim bihadiyyatin fanāẓiratun bima yarji‘ul-mursalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, behold, I am going to send a gift to those [people], and await whatever [answer] the envoys bring back.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَ سُلَيْمٰنَ قَالَ اَتُمِدُّوْنَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ اٰتٰىنِ  َۧ اللّٰهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ اٰتٰىكُمْۚ بَلْ اَنْتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'a sulaimāna qāla atumiddūnani  bimālin famā ātāniyallāhu khairum mimmā ātākum, bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafraḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now when [the Queen’s messenger] came unto Solomon, he said: “Do you people mean to add to my wealth? But that which God has given me is [so much] better than all that He has given you! Nay, it is [only such as] you that would rejoice in this gift of yours!

ayahs.textArabic: اِرْجِعْ اِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُمْ بِجُنُوْدٍ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُمْ مِّنْهَآ اَذِلَّةً وَّهُمْ صٰغِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Irji‘ ilaihim falana'tiyannahum bijunūdil lā qibala lahum bihā wa lanukhrijannahum minhā ażillataw wa hum ṣāgirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Go thou back unto them [that have sent thee]! For, [God says:] ‘We shall most certainly come upon them with forces which they will never be able to withstand, and shall most certainly cause them to be driven from that [land of theirs], despicable and humbled!’”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمَلَؤُا اَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِيْنِيْ بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ اَنْ يَّأْتُوْنِيْ مُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā ayyuhal-mala'u ayyukum ya'tīnī bi‘arsyihā qabla ay ya'tūnī muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [When Solomon learned that the Queen of Sheba was coming,] he said [to his council]: “O you nobles! Which of you can bring me her throne ere she and her followers come unto me in willing surrender to God?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ عِفْرِيْتٌ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ اَنَا۠ اٰتِيْكَ بِهٖ قَبْلَ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ مِنْ مَّقَامِكَۚ وَاِنِّيْ عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِيٌّ اَمِيْنٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla ‘ifrītum minal-jinni ana atīka bihī qabla an taqūma mim maqāmik(a), wa innī ‘alaihi laqawiyyun amīn(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said a bold one of the invisible beings [subject to Solomon]: “I shall bring it to thee ere thou rise from thy council-seat - for, behold, I am powerful enough to do it, [and] worthy of trust!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ الَّذِيْ عِنْدَهٗ عِلْمٌ مِّنَ الْكِتٰبِ اَنَا۠ اٰتِيْكَ بِهٖ قَبْلَ اَنْ يَّرْتَدَّ اِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَۗ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِنْدَهٗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنْ فَضْلِ رَبِّيْۗ  لِيَبْلُوَنِيْٓ ءَاَشْكُرُ اَمْ اَكْفُرُۗ وَمَنْ شَكَرَ فَاِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهٖۚ وَمَنْ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ رَبِّيْ غَنِيٌّ كَرِيْمٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālal-lażī ‘indahū ‘ilmum minal-kitābi ana ātīka bihī qabla ay yartadda ilaika ṭarfuk(a), falammā ra'āhu mustaqirran ‘indahū qāla hāżā min faḍli rabbī, liyabluwanī a'asykuru am akfur(u), wa man syakara fa'innamā yasykuru linafsih(ī), wa man kafara fa'inna rabbī ganiyyun karīm(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Answered he who was illumined by revela­tion: “[Nay,] as for me - I shall bring it to thee ere the twinkling of thy eye ceases!” And when he saw it truly before him, he exclaimed: “This is [an outcome] of my Sustainer’s bounty, to test me as to whether I am grateful or ungrateful! However, he who is grateful [to God] is but grateful for his own good; and he who is ungrate­ful [should know that], verily, my Sustainer is self-sufficient, most generous in giving!”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ نَكِّرُوْا لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنْظُرْ اَتَهْتَدِيْٓ اَمْ تَكُوْنُ مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla nakkirū lahā ‘arsyahā nanẓur atahtadī am takūnu minal-lażīna lā yahtadūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And] he continued: Alter her throne so that she may not know it as hers: let us see whether she allows herself to be guided [to the truth] or remains one of those who will not be guided.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَلَمَّا جَاۤءَتْ قِيْلَ اَهٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِۗ قَالَتْ كَاَنَّهٗ هُوَۚ وَاُوْتِيْنَا الْعِلْمَ مِنْ قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Falammā jā'at qīla ahakażā ‘arsyuk(i), qālat ka'annahū huw(a), wa ūtīnal-‘ilma min qablihā wa kunnā muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, as soon as she arrived, she was asked: “Is thy throne like this?” She answered: “It is as though it were the same!” [And Solomon said to his nobles: “She has arrived at the truth without any help from us,] although it is we who have been given [divine] knowledge before her, and have [long ago] surrendered ourselves unto God!

ayahs.textArabic: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَتْ تَّعْبُدُ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ṣaddahā mā kānat ta‘budu min dūnillāh(i), innahā kānat min qaumin kāfirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And she has recognized the truth] although that which she has been wont to worship instead of God had kept her away [from the right path]: for, behold, she is descended of people who deny the truth!”

ayahs.textArabic: قِيْلَ لَهَا ادْخُلِى الصَّرْحَۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةً وَّكَشَفَتْ عَنْ سَاقَيْهَاۗ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ صَرْحٌ مُّمَرَّدٌ مِّنْ قَوَارِيْرَ ەۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ اِنِّيْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِيْ وَاَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمٰنَ لِلّٰهِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Qīla lahadkhuliṣ-ṣarḥ(a), falammā ra'athu ḥasibathu lujjataw wa kasyafat ‘an sāqaihā, qāla innahū ṣarḥum mumarradum min qawārīr(a), qālat rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī wa aslamtu ma‘a sulaimāna lillāhi rabbil-‘ālamīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [After a while] she was told: “Enter this court!” - but when she saw it, she thought that it was a fathomless expanse of water, and she bared her legs. Said he: “Behold, it is [but] a court smoothly paved with glass!” Cried she: “O my Sustainer! I have been sinning against myself thy worshipping aught but Thee]: but [now] I have surrendered myself, with Solomon, unto the Sustainer of all the worlds!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَآ اِلٰى ثَمُوْدَ اَخَاهُمْ صٰلِحًا اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ فَاِذَا هُمْ فَرِيْقٰنِ يَخْتَصِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad arsalnā ilā ṡamūda akhāhum ṣāliḥan ani‘budullāha fa'iżā hum farīqāni yakhtaṣimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [likewise], indeed, We sent unto [the tribe of] Thamud their brother Salih [with this message]: “Worship God alone!” and, behold, they were [split into] two factions contending with one another.

ayahs.textArabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ الْحَسَنَةِۚ  لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُوْنَ اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāla yā qaumi lima tasta‘jilūna bis-sayyi'ati qablal-ḥasanah(ti), lau lā tastagfirūnallāha la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Said [Salih to the erring ones]: Why do you seek to hasten the coming upon you of evil instead of hoping for the good?” Why do you not, rather, ask God to forgive you your sins, so that you might be graced with His mercy?”

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوا اطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَنْ مَّعَكَۗ قَالَ طٰۤىِٕرُكُمْ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ  بَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تُفْتَنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qāluṭ ṭayyarnā bika wa bimam ma‘ak(a), qāla ṭā'irukum ‘indallāhi bal antum qaumun tuftanūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: They answered: “We augur evil from thee and those that follow thee!” Said he: “Your destiny, good or evil, rests with God yea, you are people undergoing a test!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَانَ فِى الْمَدِيْنَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍ يُّفْسِدُوْنَ فِى الْاَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kāna fil-madīnati tis‘atu rahṭiy yufsidūna fil-arḍi wa lā yuṣliḥūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now there were in the city nine men who were wont to commit deeds of depravity all over the land, and would not reform;

ayahs.textArabic: قَالُوْا تَقَاسَمُوْا بِاللّٰهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهٗ وَاَهْلَهٗ ثُمَّ لَنَقُوْلَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهٖ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ اَهْلِهٖ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qālū taqāsamū billāhi lanubayyitannahū wa ahlahū ṡumma lanaqūlanna liwaliyyihī mā syahidnā mahlika ahlihī wa innā laṣādiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and] after having bound one another by an oath in God’s name, they said: “Indeed, we shall suddenly fall upon him and his household by night [and slay them all]; and then we shall boldly say to his next of kin, ‘We did not witness the destruction of his household - and, behold, we are indeed men of truth!’”

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَكَرُوْا مَكْرًا وَّمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًا وَّهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa makarū makraw wa makarnā makraw wa hum lā yasy‘urūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so they devised an evil scheme; but We devised a subtle scheme (of Our own), and they perceived it not.

ayahs.textArabic: فَانْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ اَنَّا دَمَّرْنٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fanẓur kaifa kāna ‘āqibatu makrihim annā dammarnāhum wa qaumahum ajma‘īn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, then, what all their scheming came to in the end: We utterly destroyed them and their people, all of them;

ayahs.textArabic: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوْتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةً ۢبِمَا ظَلَمُوْاۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fatilka buyūtuhum khāwiyatam bimā ẓalamū, inna fī żālika la'āyatal liqaumiy ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and [now] those dwellings of theirs are empty, [ruined] as an outcome of their evil deeds. In this, behold, there is a message indeed for peo­ple of [innate] knowledge –

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْجَيْنَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَكَانُوْا يَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anjainal-lażīna āmanū wa kānū yattaqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: seeing that We saved those who had attained to faith and were conscious of Us,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلُوْطًا اِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهٖٓ اَتَأْتُوْنَ الْفَاحِشَةَ وَاَنْتُمْ تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lūṭan iż qāla liqaumihī ata'tūnal-fāḥisyata wa antum tubṣirūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND [thus, too, did We save] Lot, when he said unto his people: “Would you commit this abomination with your eyes open (to its being against all nature)?

ayahs.textArabic: اَىِٕنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُوْنَ الرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةً مِّنْ دُوْنِ النِّسَاۤءِ ۗبَلْ اَنْتُمْ قَوْمٌ تَجْهَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: A'innakum lata'tūnar-rijāla syahwatam min dūnin-nisā'(i), bal antum qaumun tajhalūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Must you really approach men with lust instead of women? Nay, but you are people without any awareness (of right and wrong)!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهٖٓ اِلَّآ اَنْ قَالُوْٓا اَخْرِجُوْٓا اٰلَ لُوْطٍ مِّنْ قَرْيَتِكُمْۙ اِنَّهُمْ اُنَاسٌ يَّتَطَهَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Famā kāna jawāba qaumihī illā an qālū akhrijū āla lūṭim min qaryatikum, innahum unāsuy yataṭahharūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But his people’s only answer was this: “Expel [Lot and] Lot’s followers from your township! Verily, they are folk who make themselves out to be pure!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَاَنْجَيْنٰهُ وَاَهْلَهٗٓ اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرْنٰهَا مِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa'anjaināhu wa ahlahū illamra'atahū qaddarnāhā minal-gābirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon We saved him and his household - all but his wife, whom We willed to be among those that stayed behind -

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ مَّطَرًاۚ فَسَاۤءَ مَطَرُ الْمُنْذَرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa amṭarnā ‘alaihim maṭarā(n), fasā'a maṭarul-munżarīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: the while We rained a rain [of destruction] upon the others: and dire is such rain upon all who let themselves be warned [to no avail]

ayahs.textArabic: قُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَسَلٰمٌ عَلٰى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِيْنَ اصْطَفٰىۗ ءٰۤاللّٰهُ خَيْرٌ اَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ  ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Qulil-ḥamdu lillāhi wa salāmun ‘alā ‘ibādihil-lażīnaṣṭafā, āllāhu khairun ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: SAY: “All praise is due to God, and peace be upon those servants of His whom He chose [to be His message-bearers]!” Is not God far better than anything to which men [falsely] ascribe a share in His divinity?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَاَنْزَلَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مَاۤءً فَاَنْۢبَتْنَا بِهٖ حَدَاۤىِٕقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۚ مَا كَانَ لَكُمْ اَنْ تُنْۢبِتُوْا شَجَرَهَاۗ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۗبَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ يَّعْدِلُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am man khalaqas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wa anzala minas-samā'i mā'an fa ambatnā bihī ḥadā'iqa żāta bahjah(tin), mā kāna lakum an tumbitū syajarahā, a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), bal hum qaumuy ya‘dilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay - who is it that has created the heavens and the earth, and sends down for you [life-giving] water from the skies? For it is by this means that We cause gardens of shining beauty to grow - [whereas] it is not in your power to cause [even one single of] its trees to grow! Could there be any divine power besides God? Nay, they [who think so] are people who swerve [from the path of reason]

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ جَعَلَ الْاَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَّجَعَلَ خِلٰلَهَآ اَنْهٰرًا وَّجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ الْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًاۗ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۗبَلْ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am man ja‘alal-arḍa qarāraw wa ja‘ala khilālahā anhāraw wa ja‘ala lahā rawāsiya wa ja‘ala bainal-baḥraini ḥājizā(n), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), bal akṡaruhum lā ya‘lamūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay - who is it that has made the earth a fitting abode [for living things], and has caused running waters [to flow] in its midst, and has set upon it moun­tains firm, and has placed a barrier between the two great bodies of water? Could there be any divine power besides God? Nay, most of those [who think so] do not know [what they are saying]!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ يُّجِيْبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ اِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوْۤءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَاۤءَ الْاَرْضِۗ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۗقَلِيْلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُوْنَۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Am may yujībul-muḍṭarra iżā da‘āhu wa yaksyifus-sū'a wa yaj‘alukum khulafā'a fil-arḍ(i), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), qalīlam mā tażakkarūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay - who is it that responds to the distressed when he calls out to Him, and who removes the ill [that caused the distress], and has made you inherit the earth? Could there be any divine power besides God? How seldom do you keep this in mind!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ يَّهْدِيْكُمْ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُّرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًاۢ  بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖۗ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۗتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am may yahdīkum fī ẓulumātil-barri wal-baḥri wa may yursilur-riyāḥa busyram baina yadai raḥmatih(ī), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), ta‘ālallāhu ‘ammā yusyrikūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay - who is it that guides you in the midst of the deep darkness of land and sea, and sends forth the winds as a glad tiding of His coming grace? Could there be any divine power besides God? Sublimely exalted is God above anything to which men may ascribe a share in His divinity!

ayahs.textArabic: اَمَّنْ يَّبْدَؤُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُهٗ وَمَنْ يَّرْزُقُكُمْ مِّنَ السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِۗ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۗقُلْ هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Am may yabda'ul-khalqa ṡumma yu‘īduhū wa may yarzuqukum minas-samā'i wal-arḍ(i), a'ilāhum ma‘allāh(i), qul hātū burhānakum in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Nay - who is it that creates [all life] in the first instance, and then brings it forth anew? And who is it that provides you with sustenance out of heaven and earth? Could there be any divine power besides God? Say: “[If you think so,] produce your evidence - if you truly believe in your claim!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ الْغَيْبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ ۗوَمَا يَشْعُرُوْنَ اَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul lā ya‘lamu man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍil gaiba illallāh(u), wa mā yasy‘urūna ayyāna yub‘aṡūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “None in the heavens or on earth knows the hidden reality [of anything that exists: none knows it] save God.” And neither can they [who are living] perceive when they shall be raised from the dead:

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ ادّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى الْاٰخِرَةِۗ بَلْ هُمْ فِيْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهَاۗ بَلْ هُمْ مِّنْهَا عَمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Balid dāraka ‘ilmuhum fil-ākhirah(ti), bal hum fī syakkim minhā, bal hum minhā ‘amūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: nay, their knowledge of the life to come stops short of the truth: nay, they are [often] in doubt as to its reality: nay, they are blind to it.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا ءَاِذَا كُنَّا تُرٰبًا وَّاٰبَاۤؤُنَآ اَىِٕنَّا لَمُخْرَجُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālal-lażīna kafarū a'iżā kunnā turābaw wa ābā'unā a'innā lamukhrajūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, they who are bent on denying the truth are saying: “What! After we have become dust - we and our forefathers - shall we [all], forsooth, be brought forth [from the dead]?

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هٰذَا نَحْنُ وَاٰبَاۤؤُنَا مِنْ قَبْلُۙ اِنْ هٰذَآ اِلَّآ اَسَاطِيْرُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad wu‘idnā hāżā naḥnu wa ābā'unā min qabl(u), in hāżā illā asāṭīrul-awwalīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Indeed, we were promised this - we and our forefathers - in the past as well; it is nothing but fables of ancient times!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ سِيْرُوْا فِى الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mujrimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Go all over the earth and behold what happened in the end to those [who were thus] lost in sin!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُنْ فِيْ ضَيْقٍ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā taḥzan ‘alaihim wa lā takun fī ḍaiqim mimmā yamkurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But do not grieve over them, and neither be distressed by the false arguments which they devise [against Gods messages].

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaqūlūna matā hāżal-wa‘du in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [when] they ask, “When is this promise [of resurrection] to be fulfilled? [Answer this, O you who believe in it,] if you are men of truth!” –

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ عَسٰٓى اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ رَدِفَ لَكُمْ بَعْضُ الَّذِيْ تَسْتَعْجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Qul ‘asā ay yakūna radifa lakum ba‘ḍul-lażī tasta‘jilūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: say thou: “It may well be that something of that which [in your ignorance] you so hastily demands has already drawn close unto you.”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ فَضْلٍ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna rabbaka lażū faḍlin ‘alan-nāsi wa lākinna akṡarahum lā yasykurūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now, verily, thy Sustainer is indeed limitless in His bounty unto men - but most of them are bereft of gratitude.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوْرُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa inna rabbaka laya‘lamu mā tukinnu ṣudūruhum wa mā yu‘linūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But, verily, thy Sustainer knows all that their hearts conceal as well as all that they bring into the open:

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا مِنْ غَاۤىِٕبَةٍ فِى السَّمَاۤءِ وَالْاَرْضِ اِلَّا فِيْ كِتٰبٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā min gā'ibatin fis-samā'i wal-arḍi illā fī kitābim mubīn(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: for there is nothing [so deeply] hidden in the heavens or on earth but is recorded in [His] clear decree.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنَ يَقُصُّ عَلٰى بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ اَكْثَرَ الَّذِيْ هُمْ فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżal-qur'āna yaquṣṣu ‘alā banī isrā'īla akṡaral-lażī hum fīhi yakhtalifūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, this Qur’an explains to the children of Israel most [of that] whereon they hold divergent views;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنَّهٗ لَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa innahū lahudaw wa raḥmatul lil-mu'minīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and, verily, it is a guidance and a grace unto all who believe [in it].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِيْ بَيْنَهُمْ بِحُكْمِهٖۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْعَلِيْمُۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna rabbaka yaqḍī bainahum biḥukmih(ī), wa huwal-‘azīzul-‘alīm(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, [O believer,] thy Sustainer will judge between them in His wisdom - for He alone is almighty, all-knowing.

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۗاِنَّكَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ الْمُبِيْنِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fatawakkal ‘alallāh(i), innaka ‘alal-ḥaqqil mubīn(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, place thy trust in God [alone] - for, behold, that in which thou believest is truth self-evident.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰى وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَاۤءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Innaka lā tusmi‘ul-mautā wa lā tusmi‘uṣ-ṣummad-du‘ā'a iżā wallau mudbirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [But,] verily, thou canst not make the dead hear: and [so, too,] thou canst not make the deaf [of heart] hear this call when they turn their backs [on thee] and go away,

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَنْتَ بِهٰدِى الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلٰلَتِهِمْۗ اِنْ تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَنْ يُّؤْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā anta bihādil-‘umyi ‘an ḍalālatihim, in tusmi‘u illā may yu'minu bi'āyātinā fahum muslimūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: just as thou canst not lead the blind [of heart] out of their error; none canst thou make hear save such as [are willing to] believe in Our messages, and thus surrender themselves unto Us.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَاِذَا وَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ اَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَاۤبَّةً مِّنَ الْاَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ اَنَّ النَّاسَ كَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا لَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā waqa‘al-qaulu ‘alaihim akhrajnā lahum dābbatam minal-arḍi tukallimuhum annan-nāsa kānū bi'āyātinā lā yūqinūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now, [as for the deaf and blind of heart –] when the word [of truth] stands revealed against them, We shall bring forth unto them out of the earth a creature, which will tell them that mankind had no real faith in Our messages.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِنْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ فَوْجًا مِّمَّنْ يُّكَذِّبُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma naḥsyuru min kulli ummatin faujam mimmay yukażżibu bi'āyātinā fahum yūza‘ūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And on that Day We shall gather from within every community a host of those who gave the lie to Our messages; and they will be grouped [according to the gravity of their sins]

ayahs.textArabic: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَاۤءُوْ قَالَ اَكَذَّبْتُمْ بِاٰيٰتِيْ وَلَمْ تُحِيْطُوْا بِهَا عِلْمًا اَمَّاذَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥattā iżā jā'ū qāla akażżabtum bi'āyātī wa lam tuḥīṭū bihā ‘ilman ammāżā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: until such a time as they shall come [to be judged. And] He will say: “Did you give the lie to My messages even though you failed to encompass them with [your] knowledge? Or what was it that [you thought] you were doing?”

ayahs.textArabic: وَوَقَعَ الْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِمَا ظَلَمُوْا فَهُمْ لَا يَنْطِقُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa waqa‘al-qaulu ‘alaihim bimā ẓalamū fahum lā yanṭiqūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And the word [of truth] will stand revealed against them in the face of all the wrong which they had committed, and they will not [be able to] utter a single word [of excuse]:

ayahs.textArabic: اَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا جَعَلْنَا الَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوْا فِيْهِ وَالنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًاۗ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Alam yarau annā ja‘alnal-laila liyaskunū fīhi wan-nahāra mubṣirā(n), inna fī żālika la'āyātil liqaumiy yu'minūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, were they not aware that it is We who had made the night for them, so that they might rest therein, and the day, to make [them] see? In this, behold, there are messages indeed for peo­ple who will believe!

ayahs.textArabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنْفَخُ فِى الصُّوْرِ فَفَزِعَ مَنْ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَنْ فِى الْاَرْضِ اِلَّا مَنْ شَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ ۗوَكُلٌّ اَتَوْهُ دٰخِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yauma yunfakhu fiṣ-ṣūri fa fazi‘a man fis-samāwāti wa man fil-arḍi illā man syā'allāh(u), wa kullun atauhu dākhirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And on that Day the trumpet [of judgment] will be sounded, and all [creatures] that are in the heavens and all that are on earth will be stricken with terror, except such as God wills [to exempt]: and in utter lowliness all will come unto Him.

ayahs.textArabic: وَتَرَى الْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةً وَّهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ السَّحَابِۗ صُنْعَ اللّٰهِ الَّذِيْٓ اَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍۗ اِنَّهٗ خَبِيْرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa taral-jibāla taḥsabuhā jāmidataw wa hiya tamurru marras saḥāb(i), ṣun‘allāhil-lażī atqana kulla syai'(in), innahū khabīrum bimā taf‘alūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And thou wilt see the mountains, which [now] thou deemest so firm, pass away as clouds pass away: a work of God, who has ordered all things to per­fection! Verily, He is fully aware of all that you do!

ayahs.textArabic: مَنْ جَاۤءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهَاۚ وَهُمْ مِّنْ فَزَعٍ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ اٰمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Man jā'a bil-ḥasanati falahū khairum minhā, wa hum min faza‘iy yauma'iżin āminūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: Whoever shall come [before Him] with a good deed will gain [further] good there from; and they will be secure from the terror of that Day.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَنْ جَاۤءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فِى النَّارِۗ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa man jā'a bis-sayyi'ati fakubbat wujūhuhum fin-nār(i), hal tujzauna illā mā kuntum ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they who shall come with evil deeds – their faces will be thrust into the fire, [and they will be asked:] “Is this aught but a just requital for what you were doing [in life]?”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَآ اُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هٰذِهِ الْبَلْدَةِ الَّذِيْ حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهٗ كُلُّ شَيْءٍ وَّاُمِرْتُ اَنْ اَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā umirtu an a‘buda rabba hāżihil-baldatil-lażī ḥarramahā wa lahū kullu syai'iw wa umirtu an akūna minal-muslimīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [SAY, O Muhammad:] “I have been bidden to worship the Sustainer of this City – Him who has made it sacred, and unto whom all things belong: and I have been bidden to be of those who surrender themselves to Him,

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْ اَتْلُوَا الْقُرْاٰنَ ۚفَمَنِ اهْتَدٰى فَاِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِيْ لِنَفْسِهٖۚ وَمَنْ ضَلَّ فَقُلْ اِنَّمَآ اَنَا۠ مِنَ الْمُنْذِرِيْنَ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa an atluwal-qur'ān(a), famanihtadā fa'innamā yahtadī linafsih(ī), wa man ḍalla faqul innamā ana minal-munżirīn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and to convey this Qur’an [to the world].” Whoever, therefore, chooses to follow the right path, follows it but for his own good; and if any wills to go astray, say [unto him]: “I am only a warner.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ سَيُرِيْكُمْ اٰيٰتِهٖ فَتَعْرِفُوْنَهَاۗ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qulil-ḥamdu lillāhi sayurīkum āyātihī fata‘rifūnahā, wa mā rabbuka bigāfilin ‘ammā ta‘malūn(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: And say: “All praise is due to God! In time He will make you see [the truth of] His messages, and then you shall know them [for what they are].” And thy Sustainer is not unmindful of whatever you all may do.
